your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Vermont completes p4's light blue, and p4 has $1512 to build right away, so cash alone isn't enough. If I get Atlantic I'll hold 2 of the 3 yellows (Marvin is still unowned), plus $350 to rebuild. Don't drop below Atlantic plus about $250.

Yellow is 2/3 for me, red would only be 1/3, so a fair swap should favor me. I'd accept Indiana plus about $400. Otherwise I keep the yellows.

$596 now. No trade gets me a set, so keep the cash as a buffer against the light blues and Dark Blue. Still want Marvin, NC and Penn. If cash runs short, mortgage Baltic first.

Checking opponent positions, only p4 is close enough to land on yellow, and with $484 cash they'd easily absorb a one-house Atlantic rent of $110, so building now won't meaningfully pressure them -- I'll hold off on building and preserve the cash buffer instead.
